name: advanced tuck planche
description: A planche hold with the knees bent but the hips raised and opened so the back is flat. It needs far more lean than the tuck planche.
instructions: Get into a tuck planche with straight arms and hands turned slightly out.
Push your hips back and up until your back is flat and level.
Lean your shoulders well past your hands to stay balanced.
Push the floor away and round your upper back slightly.
Hold, then lower your feet with control.
